scope: Audit all 28 existing direct skill-to-release-event mappings against the authoritative release registry.

findings.note: Crimson Edge, Divine Spear, Big Bang Knuckle, and Wild Stinger are explicitly named by the Dragon Ball Official Site as Chapter 1 character special moves.

The registry pairs official Chapter 2 material with the maintained independent catalog for the seven named skills. The official material establishes the DLC and avatar-equippable skills, while the independent catalog supplies the individual names.

The registry currently relies on the maintained independent catalog for the six individual Chapter 3 skill identities; the official registry establishes the Chapter 3 event itself. No unsupported IDs or event assignments were found.

The four canonical skills are associated with Chapter 4 by the current registry's independent acquisition/skill guide evidence and PQ185/PQ186 reward evidence. Official Chapter 4 material establishes the DLC and its new moves, but does not yet expose all four names in the cited official source.
Beast is explicitly identified as the Awoken Skill added in Free Update #16.

The six named DAIMA Pack skills remain separated from the accompanying Free Update 20 skills. Official release evidence establishes the paid pack; named skill mapping is retained only where the repository already has direct skill-event evidence.

important_boundary: The audit validates provenance classification; it does not convert research dates into game versions and does not infer balance-patch history.
next: Strengthen the six Chapter 3 and four Chapter 4 individual skill mappings with primary-source named-move evidence where available, without weakening or replacing existing corroborated evidence.
